text: The **JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 (GFC2020) dataset** shows that there was **no forest** on the property in 2020 (area = 0 ha). Meanwhile, Hansen GFC data indicates forest loss events *before* 2020, including a significant loss of 67.7 ha in 2020 itself—suggesting the forest was largely cleared by the end of the year. Thus, no dataset confirms forest presence *after* 2020, but the JRC 2020 baseline explicitly records its absence by December 31, 2020.
